name: Hijiri Shuzo
about: Hijiri Shuzo has brewed since 1841 in Kitatachibana, Shibukawa, Gunma, on the south-western slope of Mount Akagi. The name comes from a poem by Otomo no Tabito, in which hijiri means clear sake. The eighth generation now runs the company.

Its flagship is Kanto no Hana, with Hijiri, Hizirizm and Meiho Akagi alongside it. Since 2006 the main rice has been Hitomebore, grown by local farmers, and contract-grown Gohyakumangoku has been added since 2019. The brewery has used its own toji since 2010.
